evaluation_period.note: Earlier rows are scored only to warm up rolling windows; they are never evaluated.

parameters.threshold_policy: quantiles of each signal over the TRAINING period only; absolute values resolved at runtime

rules.R3_SUSTAINED_JOINT: smoothed coupled probability >= 0.6888 (train p90) for 2 consecutive days
rules.R4_RISING_FLOOD: smoothed flood probability >= 0.5160 (train p75) AND rising by >= 0.0482 (train p90) over 3 days
rules.R5_RISING_LANDSLIDE: smoothed landslide probability >= 0.1315 (train p75) AND rising by >= 0.0677 (train p90) over 3 days
rules.R6_ENV_PRECURSOR: smoothed coupled probability >= 0.5855 (train p75) AND rainfall rising by >= 17.32 mm/day (train p95) AND soil moisture rising by >= 0.0233 (train p90), rates over 3 days
rules.R7_JOINT_MODERATE: smoothed flood probability >= 0.5360 AND smoothed landslide probability >= 0.1615 simultaneously (both train p80) -- joint moderate risk where neither hazard alone reaches 0.5

event_source.method: first day of each run of consecutive hazard days per location (onset = hazard==1 and previous day != 1)
event_source.resolution: daily (00:00); the master dataset has no time-of-day component
event_source.external_hook: place a CSV at models/real/event_timestamps.csv with columns date,latitude,longitude,hazard_type,event_timestamp to use real hour-resolution timestamps instead

any_hazard.lead_time_unit_note: Lead-time fields named *_hours are DATE-QUANTISED: the data has daily resolution, so each value is a whole number of days x 24, not an hour-level timing. Divide by 24 for days. Names are kept for API compatibility.

interpretation_notes.data: REAL DATA -- TCDL V1.0 applied unchanged to the real Flood / Landslide XGBoost models on the real Kerala district-day Master Dataset (14 districts, 2012-01-30..2024-12-31). Research outputs, not operational warnings: probabilities are uncalibrated, event onsets are derived from district-day labels (0 = not reported), and the test period holds very few landslide days.
interpretation_notes.scope: TCDL V1.0 is a PROPOSED rule-based coupling mechanism. This file measures whether it helps; it does not claim that it maximises lead time.
interpretation_notes.structural_dominance: Rules R1/R2 replicate the two single-model baselines exactly, so the coupled warning set is a superset of their union and cannot warn later or detect fewer events. That is a construction artefact. The 'tcdl_coupling_rules_only' system isolates the contribution of rules R3-R7, and false-alarm rates are reported alongside every lead time.
interpretation_notes.lead_time: MISSING DATA: the project has no real event onset timestamps and the master dataset has no time-of-day component. Lead time is quantised to 24 h and is an UPPER BOUND -- the true value lies within 24 h below each reported figure. Supply models/real/event_timestamps.csv to obtain hour-resolution results.
